previous_goal_turn.reason: Completed2600 actual controls and matched-data intervention; fixed real-harm gate failed, so the candidate is stopped.

question: Does an existing native consumer mistake a goal-conditioned planned future for the risk of a fixed action intervention, and is there a matched low-cost pretrained evaluation resource?

semantic_gate.legitimate_goal_dependence: P(Y|O,G) may describe a goal-dependent future policy, or incorporate task information about hidden state. Goal sensitivity alone is not a fault.
semantic_gate.invariant_physical_event: Only a preference-only Goal with no physical/informational path, fixed physical state or belief, complete intervened control sequence, paired exogenous randomness and one fixed event E(Y) justifies equal physical event probabilities.
semantic_gate.different_outcome_not_equivalent: Task failure, policy violation or progress can depend on the Goal by definition. They must not be substituted for a fixed physical collision event.
semantic_gate.decision_requirement: Find the actual risk-to-action or permission path and verify competent Clean against independent physical outcomes. An added risk threshold or planner must be disclosed as a new system.
semantic_gate.novelty: These are causal/evaluation requirements, not a proposed new contribution.

existing_resource_screen.finding: The explicit world-head isolation design does not imply a native forecast-ranking consumer. Native evaluation decides actions before requesting the forecast and executes those actions.
existing_resource_screen.corrected_image_goal_planner: Unimplemented/unexecuted proposal stopped by priority, not an observed Clean failure. Six corrected3-step candidates with zero sparse utility do not establish either long-continuation failure or useful ranking. No scorer/native path newly supplied.

existing_resource_screen.finding: Current native consumers are Future/Value argmax, terminal feature distance, or predicted reward plus Q. Existing registered routes already cover these operations; no new independent fixed-event risk permission interface was found.

GST receives pedestrian history/visibility, not robot Goal. Five calibration radii affect the native actor but are internally computed. The inspected robot.visible=False configuration does not support the proposed ego-goal-induced pedestrian reaction mechanism.

new_public_source.whole_future_consumer: Value uses current plus all supplied future frames through temporal attention; the server passes video_np[1:]. Endpoint-only safety-history blindness is not supported by this implementation.
new_public_source.separate_service_fields: GenerateRequest contains prompt and task separately; the generation call receives prompt and candidate actions, and value receives task. Exact model text-conditioning semantics, including guidance0, were not inferred.
new_public_source.native_call_gap: Published deployment imports agilex_infer_dinov2_value_switch._dreamdojo_generate, absent from the complete85-entry official tree. Mapping deployment task_description into service fields remains unverified.
new_public_source.resource_gap: No matched task policy/trigger/world/value/stats bundle or complete simulation evaluator found in the inspected official tree, README and empty releases list. This is a bounded search, not a claim of global unavailability.
new_public_source.integration_only_defect: Full server supplies checkpoint_path to a constructor accepting ckpt_path. Not tested at runtime and not promoted to a security mechanism.
new_public_source.decision: Retain fixed source; do not download generic backbones, rebuild missing deployment from guesses or launch a Clean panel for an unaccepted mechanism.

primary_sources.title: Planning with Diffusion for Flexible Behavior Synthesis
primary_sources.use: Goal-conditioned trajectory generation can be intentional planning rather than an invariant fixed-action prediction.

primary_sources.title: Calibrated Predictive Safety for Heterogeneous Robots
primary_sources.use: The stated architecture separates learned ranking from a hard admissibility predicate; learned scores cannot enlarge the admissible set under that design. The physical guarantee remains conditional on the shield model assumptions.
primary_sources.resource_limit: The inspected paper links no matching runnable source/weight bundle. This project has not reproduced its reported metrics and uses it only as a source of architectural distinctions.

primary_sources.title: DreamAvoid
primary_sources.use: Pinned native source and bounded resource checks recorded in the new cache.

primary_sources.title: SafePred
primary_sources.use: Predictive risks are evaluated against safety policies and goal alignment; task-dependent policy violation is not automatically a goal-invariant physical event.

safepred_followup_scope.finding: Tree search can return the lowest-risk dead-end root when all child paths are pruned, while its predictor is intended to assess short- and long-term risks.
safepred_followup_scope.no_new_harm_inference: A synthetic example labeling an unavoidable dangerous root safe would already violate the intended long-term risk semantics. Finite rejected child proposals also do not certify every possible continuation unsafe. No oracle-correct harmful execution or new task experiment was claimed from source alone.

activity.public_source_requests: Root used web research plus local reads; the separately logged DreamAvoid cache subtask used9 caller-initiated public GETs. Internal web fetch/redirect counts are not exposed.

decision: No new security experiment accepted. Preserve all previous actual harm and negative results; do not reopen the fixed nullspace, GenSafeNav or Cosmos gates by changing seeds/tasks/doses.
next_required_fact: A materially distinct mechanism with a concrete writable boundary and a matched native decision consumer, plus a decisive test against actual consequences. Mere resource availability or Goal-sensitive forecasts are insufficient.
limitations: This round adds source/resource evidence only, not task harm or defense.
